unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts the closing sentence of para 2, which the first draft kept. That sentence makes the education interesting 'only with that understanding' of full partnership. V2's 'this is the only interest in the story' now answers a premise the reader no longer has. The 'consenting, contracting party' sentence survives, but it is no longer tied to why the story matters.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The consent idea and 'excellent hand' survive, as the plan requires.

evidence.quote: Only with that understanding--as a consciously assenting member in full partnership with the society of his age--had his education an interest to himself or to others.
Only with that understanding--as a consciously assenting member in full partnership with the society of his age--had his education an interest to himself or to others.

but this is the only interest in the story, which otherwise has no moral and little incident.

unresolved_should_improve.title: Para 2 loses the premise that the consenting partnership gives the education its 'interest'

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision deletes the sentence that the education 'started in 1838' and went on while the baby grew and the world readied his universe. Para 4 now opens abruptly with 'For him, alone.' V3's 'all this that was being done' then points only to May 1844 events, which the next sentences place after a memory from age three in 1841.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 1838 remains prominent in paras 1–2, so dependency 0 is unaffected.

evidence.quote: This problem of education, started in 1838, went on for three years, while the baby grew, like other babies, unconsciously, as a vegetable
This problem of education, started in 1838, went on for three years, while the baby grew, like other babies, unconsciously, as a vegetable

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first-draft opening sentence of para 4.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Supports the required V3 and the essential '1844 cut' section.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The ironic contrast between ongoing world change and the infant's single impression of yellow loses its time frame. The sequence reads as a jump backward from age six to age three without the ongoing process that justified it.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Cut of the '1838...three years' sentence muddles the timeline behind V3

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft kept the clause in which the seasonal division 'ran through life' as 'irreconcilable problems, irreducible opposites' with growing emphasis to the end. The revision stops at 'most decisive force he ever knew.' The explicit forward reach of the opposition is gone.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: V4 and V5 survive, and dependency 1 carries unity/multiplicity forward.

evidence.quote: it ran though life, and made the division between its perplexing, warring, irreconcilable problems, irreducible opposites, with growing emphasis to the last year of study.
it ran through life, and made the division between its perplexing, warring, irreconcilable problems, irreducible opposites

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the clause as it appears in the first draft.

unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The book context names these oppositions as recurring until the closing dynamic theory. Without the clause, the opposition reads as a childhood impression rather than the lifelong structure the chapter seeds.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Seasons' opposition no longer said to run through life to the 'last year of study'

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft removed three things that cast the defeat as a political-theory farce: the President as 'a tool of tyranny' who did 'his disreputable work with a certain intelligence,' 'nullifying the social compact,' and 'hardly even a consciousness of the boy's existence.' The revision keeps these cuts. The last phrase also prepares the Polk joke.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Inalienable rights of boys,' the Polk joke and the 'stoniest soil' close all survive.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'though a tool of tyranny, had done his disreputable work with a certain intelligence' and 'hardly even a consciousness of the boy's existence.'
